hero.headline: Own the software your business runs on.
hero.subheadline: The everyday tools your business depends on - files, email, chat, booking, CRM, and more - on a server that's yours.

features.title: The environment that runs your services
features.subtitle: Catena installs to a dedicated VPS or computer you own to securely provide integrated capabilities.

secure_connections.title: Secure connections
secure_connections.body: Reach your services through dedicated Admin and App tunnels, with DDoS protection and network-port reconciliation.

backups.title: Backups
backups.body: Keep your data safe with verifiable, incremental backups.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.body: One login across every service, with role-based permissions and an audit trail.

safe_updates.title: Safe updates
safe_updates.body: Your infrastructure and services stay up to date automatically, with continuous threat monitoring and automatic fault recovery.

admin_dashboard.title: Admin dashboard
admin_dashboard.body: Monitor your infrastructure, services, users, and their permissions from a single, unified pane of glass.

monitoring.title: Monitoring and alerts
monitoring.body: Get alerts when a service goes down or the server's resources are overused.

apps.title: An app for every need
apps.intro: Host your own apps or discover hundreds of them to host and share your files, manage your photos, talk with your teammates and friends, manage your business, and so much more!
apps.discover: Discover apps on awweso.me or find alternatives to Big Tech services at openalternative.co.
apps.catalog: Check out our pre-integrated app catalog at github.com/catenahq/catena-templates or learn how to configure your apps' deployment for Catena.

pricing_matrix.title: Community, Pro, or Enterprise
pricing_matrix.intro: You host every edition. Community is free and self-hosted. Pro adds the automation that keeps it patched, backed up, and monitored automatically. Enterprise adds dedicated support and per-app SLAs. Here is what each one includes.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: The fastest way to reach us is a 30-minute discovery call. We do not pitch on first contact -- we ask questions and work out together whether Catena is the right fit.
contact.response_body: We aim to reply within one business day.
contact.about_body: Catena is led by Marc-Antoine Lalonde. What you get is judgment about which tools to pick, knowing how they fail, and owning them end to end - not a list of features.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Catena does not share, sell, rent, or train AI on your data. The whole point of the suite is that you own it.
privacy.collect_body: Billing information (via Stripe -- card numbers never touch our servers). Credentials you enter to deploy your suite are passed in-flight to our deployment runner and are not persisted in our database. Server-side logs of our actions for support and audit.
privacy.dont_body: We do not sell, rent, or share your data. We do not train AI models on it. We do not analyze it for advertising. We do not use third-party trackers on the marketing site.
privacy.where_body: Your suite data lives on the server you own, the S3 bucket you own, and the third-party accounts you yourself selected (Cloudflare, Tailscale, your VPS provider, your SMTP provider, etc.).
privacy.subprocessors_body: Stripe (payment processing). Cloudflare (Tunnel + edge for catena.run). Keycloak (identity, on our infrastructure). The providers you yourself selected for your suite (named in your engagement letter).
privacy.rights_body: Law 25 and PIPEDA grant you the right to access, correct, and delete personal information we hold. Contact privacy@catena.run (or hello@catena.run interim) and we will respond within 30 days.
privacy.cookies_body: No third-party trackers, no advertising cookies, no cookies on the marketing site. Aggregate visit analytics on the marketing site via a self-hosted Plausible instance -- no cookies, no fingerprinting, no personal data; Law 25 / GDPR compliant with no consent banner required.
privacy.contact_body: Email hello@catena.run. We answer privacy questions within one business day.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms cover the relationship between Catena (the service provider) and you (the client). They are deliberately concise -- the engagement letter you sign at signup is the canonical contract; this page summarizes its main commitments.
terms.review_notice: This page is a draft pending legal review. Talk to us directly for the binding terms in your engagement letter.
terms.scope_body: Your Catena Pro subscription -- one flat retainer per server, unlimited apps -- defines what is included, with hands-on support billed hourly as used. See the pricing section for the public model. Changes to scope are agreed in writing.
terms.billing_body: The managed subscription is one flat retainer per server, billed monthly, with no minimum term. Hands-on support is billed at the published rate in 15-minute increments, as used. Card processing via Stripe.
terms.ownership_body: All client data, infrastructure, and credentials belong to the client. Our role is service provider only. You can export and migrate at any time; the engagement letter documents the handover process.
terms.liability_body: Liability is capped at amounts proportionate to the most recent monthly retainer; the binding limits are set out in your engagement letter.
terms.sla_body: Target uptime, response times, and recovery objectives for restore drills are set out in your engagement letter and reviewed at the quarterly check-in.
terms.aup_body: No illegal content, no unsolicited bulk email (spam), no malware distribution, no resale of the suite as-a-service to third parties without prior agreement. Standard internet-services posture.
terms.termination_body: Either party may terminate per the engagement letter. On termination, we hand over the suite and the client's S3 export; data retained on Catena-owned systems is purged within 30 days.
terms.perservice_body: Each upstream app in the suite carries its own license and acceptable-use policy (Nextcloud GPL, Rocket.Chat MIT, Euro Office AGPL, etc.). Each upstream's official terms are linked from that app's documentation.
terms.law_body: Quebec, Canada. Disputes go to the courts of the judicial district of Montreal.
